Dozens Die in Nigeria from Suspected Poisoned Alcohol and Custodial Deaths

In Nigeria, nearly 50 people have died after consuming suspected methanol-laced local alcohol. Separately, at least 37 suspected illegal miners have died while in the custody of a paramilitary agency in central Nigeria. The custodial deaths have led to protests. The exact number of deaths in custody varies slightly across reports, with figures ranging from 33 to 37.
